We're seeking a talented engineer to lead the development, deployment, and management of web services and infrastructure that empower AI-driven products and initiatives. Take ownership of architecting scalable solutions utilizing technologies like MySQL, Vitess, Kafka, Cassandra, Redis, and big data platforms to support sophisticated AI applications and workflows.

Has 5+ years of experience in developing and architecting large-scale web services, preferably with exposure to supporting AI systems.
Possesses expert proficiency in Python or other programming languages such as Go, Java, or C++.
Has extensive experience with web frameworks like Django and is comfortable integrating systems with technologies such as MySQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kafka, and Cassandra, particularly in support of AI workflows.
Has hands-on experience deploying and managing services on AWS, particularly those interfacing with machine learning platforms.
Is driven by ownership and passionate about delivering impactful solutions from conception to deployment, especially in collaborative environments with AI-focused teams.
Brings substantial production server experience or equivalent backend expertise to the table.
Has excellent communication skills, a genuine curiosity for technology, and meticulous attention to detail.
Nice to haves
Familiarity with HTTP, networking principles, and API design patterns beneficial to AI integrations.
Experience with operating systems, particularly Linux, and an understanding of their interactions with AI applications and services.

The Opportunity
As a Growth Marketing Manager, you will be a key driver of Otter’s user acquisition engine—owning and scaling paid social channels while building a modern, AI-powered growth system. You’ll report to the Head of Growth Acquisition and combine performance marketing, creative intuition, and data-driven thinking to unlock scalable growth. This role is ideal for someone who moves fast, thinks in experiments, and is excited to leverage AI to improve marketing workflows and outcomes.
Your Impact
Own Paid Social: Lead strategy, execution, and scaling across Meta, YouTube, TikTok, and emerging channels. Manage campaigns end-to-end and drive performance against CPA, LTV/CAC, and ROAS targets.
Drive Creative-Led Growth: Rapidly test and iterate on UGC, video, and static ads. Partner cross-functionally to turn performance insights into high-performing assets while staying within brand guidelines.
Build AI-Native Workflows: Leverage AI across creative, testing, and analysis to move faster, automate workflows, and scale what works. Help define what a modern, AI-native growth stack looks like at Otter.
Experiment and Scale: Run structured, high-velocity experiments across audiences, creatives, and funnels—quickly turning insights into action. Go deep on performance data to identify scaling opportunities and inefficiencies.
Grow Affiliate/Creator/Influencer Channels: Build and scale partnerships across influencers, publishers, and communities, owning the lifecycle from sourcing to optimization.
Optimize the Full Funnel: Improve landing pages, messaging, and conversion flows—driving impact beyond conversions.
We’re Looking for Someone Who
7+ years in growth, performance marketing, or user acquisition, with a minimum of a BA in Economics/Business or a BS in Math, Computer Science, Statistics, or another engineering discipline
Experience managing and scaling paid social channels with at least a 6-figure monthly budget per channel
Comfortable being in the weeds daily: launching campaigns, pulling data, and iterating on creatives
Strong analytical foundation (CAC, LTV, retention, incrementality) paired with strong creative instincts (what makes ads convert)
Already using AI tools in your workflow and excited to push the edge of what AI can do in growth marketing
Experience with analytics tools such as Amplitude, HubSpot, Appsflyer, Google Analytics, etc.
Strong understanding of attribution, tracking, and measurement (GTM, MMPs, pixels)
Experience in fast-growing PLG or subscription businesses with LTV/CAC-focused acquisition is a plus

We are looking for a Senior AI Agent & LLM Engineer who combines strong software engineering capabilities with a deep focus on AI quality. You will help build and improve the AI systems behind Otter’s conversational knowledge engine and AI Chat, spanning user-facing agent experiences, evaluation systems, and the shared platform required to operate them reliably at scale.

Can use data, traces, logs, and qualitative examples to identify and resolve complex failures.
Works effectively across services, technical domains, and organizational boundaries.
Combines strong product judgment with rigorous engineering and evaluation practices.
Operates with high agency, strong ownership, and a bias toward action.
Can take ambiguous problems from initial exploration through production launch and continuous improvement.

Otter.ai turns conversations into knowledge. Millions of people use our AI meeting assistant to capture, transcribe, and act on what's said in meetings — and we're the category's clearest name-brand product. But "clearest name-brand" and "best-known story" aren't the same thing. As AI note-takers and meeting assistants become table stakes, Otter needs a sharper, more distinctive voice to defend and extend its lead.
We're hiring our first Head of Brand & Storytelling to give Otter.ai that voice. This is a builder's role: you'll bring structure to a brand promise, tone, and identity that reflect our evolution, and you'll turn that foundation into the narratives, media moments, and content that make the case — loudly and credibly — that Otter.ai is the category leader.
You'll own brand strategy end to end, including PR, communications, social, and community. Leading this small team, you'll be in the room defining the brand promise and in the weeds writing the press release, briefing the analysts, and shipping the social post.
Great storytelling requires great storytellers, words are your passion and you feel at the top of your craft. Knowing how and where those words drive impact is your superpower.
Your Impact
Brand Strategy & Identity
Define and codify Otter's brand promise, personality, tone of voice, and verbal identity system. Make sure it's usable, not just aspirational (think brand guidelines people actually open).
Be the internal source of truth on what Otter sounds and feels like, partnering with product, design, and marketing so the brand shows up consistently everywhere — in-product copy, campaigns, sales decks, support, social.
Evolve brand positioning as the category shifts from "meeting transcription" to AI-native conversational intelligence, keeping Otter ahead of where the market is going, not just where it's been.
Own the strategy for brand campaigns, working with our in-house creative team and agencies to increase brand awareness.
Narrative & Thought Leadership
Build the core narratives that position Otter.ai as the category leader. A point of view on the future of voice, turning meetings into action, and AI that's distinct from "another AI notetaker."
Develop executive thought leadership (bylines, talk tracks, interviews) that puts Otter's leadership in front of the right audiences and outlets.
Turn product milestones, customer results, and market moments into stories worth covering — not just announcements.
Work with our partnerships team to develop our brand partnership, including sports and 3P events.
PR, communications, social & community:
Build out our organic social strategy and execution across channels, with a sharp point of view on which platforms and formats actually move the needle for Otter's audience.
Build and nurture community — the people who already love Otter — into a channel that reinforces the brand and drives organic advocacy.
Choose channels based on impact, not habit: know where your audience actually pays attention and put effort there first.
Expand our PR and comms impact: press strategy, media relationships, announcement planning, and (where useful) agency management.
We're Looking For Someone Who
Has a love of their craft. You know the power of the brand and have a passion for making yours stand out in a way that drives impact.
Showcases proven chops in brand, communications, or integrated marketing roles at B2B SaaS companies, ideally including time at a company under ~$500M ARR where you had to be scrappy and hands-on rather than purely strategic.
Holds a track record of building or substantially sharpening a brand's narrative and voice — not just maintaining one you inherited.
Can leverage direct experience running PR/comms (media relationships, announcement strategy) and social/community, either as a generalist owner or across multiple prior roles.
Carries strong writing and editing skills; you can produce a sharp press release, a compelling exec byline, and a scroll-stopping social post yourself.
Operates with a comfort with ambiguity and a bias to ship: you'd rather put a workable brand framework in front of the team this month than a perfect one next quarter.
Is ready to own a function end-to-end and is equally comfortable setting the strategy and rolling up their sleeves to build.
About Otter.ai
We are in the business of shaping the future of work. Our mission is to make conversations more valuable.
With over 1B meetings transcribed, Otter.ai is the world’s leading tool for meeting transcription, summarization, and collaboration. Using artificial intelligence, Otter generates real-time automated meeting notes, summaries, and other insights from in-person and virtual meetings - turning meetings into accessible, collaborative, and actionable data that can be shared across teams and organizations. The company is backed by early investors in Google, DeepMind, Zoom, and Tesla.

We’re building the next generation of AI-native product experiences, where conversations turn directly into outcomes. As a Senior Software Engineer on our Product teams, you’ll own significant areas of the product and play a key role in shaping how AI capabilities translate into real user value.
You’ll work across the full lifecycle of AI-driven features—from data ingestion and model orchestration to output structuring and delivery into user-facing product surfaces. In this role, you’ll not only build features, but also design the systems that power them—ensuring that AI outputs are reliable, performant, and aligned with real user needs.
You’ll take on complex, ambiguous problems and drive them from concept to production, making thoughtful tradeoffs across latency, cost, and quality. This includes defining how LLMs, retrieval systems, and structured data come together to create cohesive product experiences.
Working closely with product, design, and AI teams, you’ll rapidly prototype and iterate on features like summaries, action items, and intelligent workflows—while helping establish patterns and best practices that other engineers can build on.
You’ll also play a key role in elevating the team: guiding technical decisions, mentoring engineers, and raising the bar for both product thinking and engineering quality.
Your Impact
Own end-to-end delivery of AI product features Lead the design and implementation of complex features—from initial concept through production—ensuring high quality and strong user impact.
Drive system design for AI-backed experiences Architect systems that orchestrate LLMs, retrieval, and structured data, making thoughtful tradeoffs between flexibility, reliability, and performance.
Elevate product quality through iteration and evaluation Establish and improve feedback loops (evaluation frameworks, user signals, experimentation) to systematically improve AI output quality.
Lead technical direction within a product area Break down ambiguous problems, define approaches, and guide execution across multiple engineers.
Mentor and raise the engineering bar Provide guidance on code quality, system design, and product thinking; help less experienced engineers operate more effectively in an AI-driven environment.
Accelerate team velocity through AI-assisted development Model effective use of modern AI tools to improve iteration speed, code quality, and overall team productivity.
We're Looking For Someone Who
Has 5+ years of experience building and scaling product-facing systems, with a track record of owning complex features or product areas end-to-end
Writes clean, maintainable code (Python preferred) and makes strong architecture and design decisions across a modern web stack
Brings a high bar for product quality, not just system correctness — consistently asks whether what's being built actually serves users well
Has experience working with AI/LLM-powered systems, or can ramp quickly and contribute meaningfully to shaping their behavior in production
Drives projects from idea → production with strong ownership, and helps others do the same through mentorship and technical leadership
Thrives in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and can set technical direction, not just execute within it
Nice to haves
Experience building or experimenting with LLM-powered features (prompting, evaluation, RAG, etc.)
Experience designing systems that balance latency, cost, and quality
Exposure to user feedback loops, experimentation, or evaluation frameworks

About The Role
Otter.ai is seeking a Director of Engineering, Infrastructure to lead the teams that power our products at scale. This leader will own our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, DevOps, site reliability practices, and production operations.
This is a hands-on, high-impact leadership role for someone who can set infrastructure strategy while going deep on critical technical and operational challenges. You will partner closely with Product, Product Engineering, AI/ML, Security, and Finance to deliver a platform that is reliable, scalable, secure, developer-friendly, and cost-efficient.
Your Impact
Own the architecture and operation of cloud, compute, networking, database, production, and AI inference infrastructure.
Translate business and product plans into infrastructure roadmaps, capacity requirements, staffing plans, and investment decisions.
Ensure production infrastructure is reliable, scalable, secure, performant, and cost-efficient.
Establish infrastructure metrics, engineering standards, observability, and clear accountability, proactively surfacing risks and opportunities.
Improve developer velocity through automation, CI/CD, and self-service tooling.
Strengthen incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices.
Partner with AI/ML teams to optimize inference performance, reliability, resource utilization, and cost.
Embed access control, compliance, and risk management into infrastructure architecture and operations.
Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing infrastructure engineering organization as a technically credible player-coach.
Communicate infrastructure priorities, risks, investments, and tradeoffs clearly to the executive team, and partner with Engineering and Finance on cost and capacity decisions.
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related technical field.
10+ years of software development or engineering experience, including 4+ years of engineering management experience.
Significant experience leading infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform teams responsible for production systems at scale.
Deep experience designing and operating highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems.
Strong knowledge of AWS and cloud-native infrastructure, including Kubernetes/EKS, EC2, Auto Scaling Groups, load balancing, networking, storage, IAM, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform.
Deep understanding of MySQL operations, including performance, replication, clustering, backup, and disaster recovery.
Strong knowledge of asynchronous architectures, including message queues, worker systems, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
Experience building strong production reliability practices, including observability, incident management, on-call operations, disaster recovery, multi-region architectures, and zero-downtime migrations.
A track record of materially improving cloud efficiency and infrastructure unit economics without compromising reliability or performance.
Experience operating latency-sensitive, high-throughput AI inference workloads in production; GPU inference optimization experience is a plus.
Experience scaling infrastructure to support rapid product and customer growth, including both self-serve products and enterprise customers with demanding security, reliability, and compliance requirements.
Ability to move effectively between architecture, operational data, financial analysis, organizational design, and executive communication, with strong cross-functional influence.
Ability to use AI-assisted engineering and operational tools to improve team productivity, incident response, diagnostics, and infrastructure management.
Familiarity with relevant application technologies such as Python, Django, FastAPI, and WebSockets.

The Opportunity
Otter.ai is looking for a driven, hands-on Sales Manager to lead and develop a team of Account Executives as we build and scale our sales organization.
This is an exciting opportunity for a sales leader who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and is passionate about developing talent, driving results, and building a culture of accountability and high performance.
Reporting to the Senior Director of Sales, you'll play a key role in strengthening our sales execution, developing a high-performing team, and helping establish the processes and operating rhythms needed to scale. We're looking for a leader who isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves — someone who leads from the front, coaches in real time, and knows how to turn strategy into results.
This role follows a hybrid work schedule, with three days per week in one of our Bay Area offices.
What You'll Do
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives, driving consistent quota attainment, pipeline generation, and revenue growth.
Build a high-performance culture grounded in clear expectations, accountability, continuous feedback, and recognition.
Take a hands-on approach to sales coaching, including joining customer calls, reviewing deals, strengthening discovery and objection handling, and helping reps navigate complex sales cycles.
Own team performance, proactively identifying gaps, delivering actionable feedback, and developing plans to improve individual and team results.
Drive outbound prospecting and pipeline generation, helping the team build and maintain a healthy, predictable pipeline.
Establish consistent operating rhythms, including pipeline reviews, deal inspections, forecasting, and regular coaching sessions.
Partner with the Senior Director of Sales to implement sales strategies, improve processes, and help build a scalable, high-performing sales organization.
Leverage sales methodologies, including MEDDPIC, to strengthen qualification, deal execution, and win rates.
Support recruiting, onboarding, and ramping new sales talent, helping new hires become productive quickly.
Use Salesforce and performance data to track KPIs, identify trends, improve forecast accuracy, and drive accountability.
Collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and other cross-functional partners to improve the customer experience and accelerate revenue growth.
Foster an environment where team members feel supported, challenged, and motivated to perform at their best.
What You Bring
6+ years of successful B2B sales experience, ideally in SaaS or a high-growth technology environment.
3+ years of experience directly managing and developing a team of quota-carrying sales professionals.
Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets, both as an individual contributor and as a sales leader.
Demonstrated ability to coach and develop sales talent, improve underperformance, and build high-performing teams.
Experience driving outbound prospecting and pipeline generation.
Strong understanding of sales methodologies, including MEDDPIC, pipeline management, forecasting, and deal execution.
Highly hands-on leadership style, with a passion for coaching through live calls, deal reviews, and ongoing feedback.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to use sales data to identify opportunities and drive performance improvements.
Experience with Salesforce CRM and sales productivity tools.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
A builder's mindset — comfortable with ambiguity, energized by change, and willing to help create and improve processes rather than simply follow established ones.
A collaborative, results-oriented leadership style with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
